youtube.title: Karna ko kin do shraapon ne gheraa? 🏹 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Karna ne Brahmin ka roop lekar Parashurama se astra-vidya seekhi. Ek din guru unki god mein sir rakhkar so gaye, tabhi ek keede ne Karna ki jaangh kaat li. Guru ki neend na tute, isliye Karna hile nahin. Jaagkar Parashurama samajh gaye ki wo Kshatriya hai aur shraap diya ki zaroorat ke samay use Brahmastra yaad nahin rahega.

Dusra shraap tab mila jab Karna ka baan anjaane mein ek Brahmin ki gaay ko lag gaya. Karna ne bahut manaya, par Brahmin ne shraap diya ki sankat ki ghadi mein dharti uske rath ka pahiya nigal legi. Yahi do shraap Karna ke jeevan ke ant tak uske saath rahe.

Katha ka strot: Mahabharata, Shanti Parva (adhyay 2-3).
